title: Deposit Relationship Schedule: The Share of a Certificate of Deposit Penalty Actually Charged
content:
Where an owner keeps a substantial deposit balance with Piedmont Crescent Bank and the certificate has been renewed at least once, only part of the penalty figure worked out on a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line is charged.

## 1. The grades

The share of the figure actually charged is graded: an owner whose active savings or money market balance is at least the tier's jumbo threshold and whose certificate has run through at least one earlier term is charged nine tenths of the figure; an owner whose active savings or money market balance is at least half the tier's jumbo threshold but below that threshold and whose certificate has run through at least one earlier term is charged nineteen twentieths of the figure; every other owner is charged the whole figure.

## 2. The figures the grades turn on

The jumbo threshold on every tier of the Certificates of Deposit line is 100000.00 USD, and half of that figure is 50000.00 USD. The balance is that of the owner's active account on the bank's Savings & Money Market Accounts line. The count of earlier terms is the number of terms the certificate has already run through.

## 3. Condition and result

| Active savings or money market balance | Earlier terms run through | Share charged |
|---|---|---|
| 100000.00 USD or more | 1 or more | nine tenths of the figure |
| 100000.00 USD or more | none | the whole figure |
| at least 50000.00, below 100000.00 USD | 1 or more | nineteen twentieths of the figure |
| at least 50000.00, below 100000.00 USD | none | the whole figure |
| below 50000.00 USD | any | the whole figure |
| no such account held | any | the whole figure |

Both balance figures are floors. A balance of exactly 100000.00 USD takes the first grade; one of exactly 50000.00 USD takes the second.

## 4. Worked readings, on a hypothetical figure

Take a penalty figure of 400.00 USD worked out on a certificate that has run through two earlier terms.

| Owner's active deposit balance | Charged |
|---|---|
| 140000.00 USD | 360.00 USD, being nine tenths of 400.00 |
| 62000.00 USD | 380.00 USD, being nineteen twentieths of 400.00 |
| 18000.00 USD | 400.00 USD |

On a certificate in its first term, all three balances give 400.00 USD, the count of earlier terms being nil.
